# Sanitized Minecraft-Derived Village POI Fixture

This directory contains sanitized Village POI structures derived from a full copy of a Minecraft-created Bedrock world (Minecraft 1.21.0).

- All personal filesystem paths, private world names, and player records have been removed.
- The compound structure, list tag layouts, integer types, `Skip` tags, `Type` flags, and instance records match Minecraft Bedrock LevelDB `VILLAGE_*_POI` storage.
